purpose: Validate a product-owned local caller-contract registry that supplies deterministic OPEN visual-fallback contracts to the already validated P5E agent loop without adding visual data to planner output or selecting a perception provider before the P5B-eligible semantic gap.
requiredClaims: The product runtime and Computer Control dependency exactly match the frozen SHAs.
The local JSON caller-contract registry is product-owned and separate from competence skill status and Computer Control.
A contract is matched exactly by application, OPEN intent and semantic target; missing matches produce no fallback contract and duplicate matches fail closed.
The caller contract contains deterministic target/postcondition and declarative perception requirements but no perception-provider object and no coordinates.
The planner output remains ordinary ACTIVATE_APP and OPEN semantic intents and contains no visual fallback metadata, provider identity, postcondition or coordinates.
Loading/selecting the caller contract does not select or execute a perception provider.
The selected caller contract is passed through the existing normal P5E runTask path.
OPEN still executes semantic-first and only a structured P5B-eligible NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET gap may resolve the lazy visual context.
Only after that eligible gap, P5D selects the optional local macOS Vision text-region provider.
P5A performs the real mapped visual fallback with explicit primary-display left-click authorization.
Computer Control CLICK_POSTED remains delivery only and semanticConsequenceVerified remains false at delivery.
A fresh independent post-action observation must satisfy the exact caller-contract postcondition before VERIFIED_SUCCESS.
Screenshot bytes, OCR payload text and coordinates are not persisted to session evidence.
Computer Use and Computer Control trees remain clean.
nonClaims: P6A does not claim a built-in application-specific visual OPEN skill is already available.
P6A does not modify the LLM planner schema.
P6A does not make visual fallback implicit when no caller contract matches.
P6A does not merge caller contracts with competence skill validation status.
P6A does not broaden P5B eligibility or weaken delivery != success.
P6A does not claim general OCR accuracy, fuzzy matching, VLM understanding, arbitrary gestures or arbitrary applications.
P1-P5 physical evidence is not rerun or rewritten.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose the exact failed boundary, fix forward only, and create s02 only if required.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned fixture content is used; frame bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: first built-in real application/task contract or skill integration chosen only from separately evidenced deterministic UI knowledge
